section_title: Private banking and wealth management risks > Special purpose vehicle risks

coverage_audit.proposition: 金融机构必须对SPV和PIV执行强化尽职调查，识别最终受益所有人并了解真实目的，这有助于减轻潜在金融犯罪风险。
coverage_audit.reason: 该部分包含金融机构的特定动作链：基于监管要求（必须进行EDD）触发具体执行动作（识别UBO和了解目的），并产生控制效果（有助于减轻风险），形成了条件-动作-结果的程序性有向结构，基础KG无法表达这种具体动作与结果的关联，有助于判断关于CDD/EDD实施义务和影响的选项。

cards.title: SPV/PIV强化尽职调查与风险缓解

flow_nodes.label: Financial institutions must be vigilant in conducting enhanced due diligence (EDD) on SPVs and PIVs and ensure compliance with CDD regulations such as the Financial Crime Enforcement Network's CDD rule
Financial institutions identify ultimate beneficial owners and understand the true purpose of these entities
Help mitigate any potential financial crime risks associated with SPVs

flow_edges.source_quote: Financial institutions must be vigilant in conducting enhanced due diligence... Financial institutions must identify ultimate beneficial owners...
Financial institutions must identify... This will help mitigate...

cards.review_notes: 增量命题：金融机构根据监管要求对SPV/PIV执行EDD（识别UBO和目的）-> 帮助减轻金融犯罪风险；KG不足：基础KG只能保存“必须进行EDD”的事实，不能表达该动作产生具体控制效果的程序性方向；选项判断：可确认或排除关于EDD实施义务及其风险缓解效果的选项；LLM推理：无。
